info.biography: 张燕，本姓褚，生卒年不详，常山真定（今河北正定南）人，东汉末年黑山军首领。张燕剽捍，敏捷过人，军中称为“飞燕”。官渡之战时投降曹操，被任命为平北将军，封安国亭侯。死后其子张方袭爵。
info.characteristic: 压制型武将，需要在【杀】的效果选择上与敌方互相博弈以取得最大收益。

implementationInferences.explanation: The pronoun 其 remains the wounded actual Play owner, independently of the freely selected Slash target. Every actual positive AfterDamageApplied occurrence from that same native Use to that participant issues one forced HE obtain through the original source instance, including a legal added target, redirected hit, chained damage or extra effect round. Non-damage/other participants never qualify; dead participants cannot supply a card. A self-overlap hand obtain is a genuine no-op while an equipped card can move into its owner's hand. The per-occurrence timing is an engine reading of the current wording, not a dedicated official FAQ.

Both participants privately commit to the same frozen available set without reading the earlier vote. Reveal occurs only after both answers. Numeric effects count votes; NoResponse is a boolean. The source owner may then add up to the counted number of distinct currently legal normally in-range targets, including zero; selected effects are not optional after voting.

UseFinished settles once after all native targets, chains, extra effect rounds, Dying and response children. Current wording 若未杀死角色 covers any actual direct damage death attributed to this same native Use, including a later recipient; an unrelated nested child death and a rescued Dying do not count. Failure removes the distinct selected options for the issuing SkillInstanceId. A new instance after loss/regrant starts with all three, as explicitly tested by the OL guide. Issued use effects survive source loss/death and cannot be re-bound to a replacement actor.
